heading: SEBI Streamlines Checks, Targets High-Risk Players
tldr: SEBI is overhauling its inspection framework for market intermediaries, moving from routine checks to a risk-based approach.
The market regulator aims to reduce the volume of inspections by two-thirds compared to previous years, enhancing efficiency.
This new strategy focuses resources on identifying and scrutinising entities that pose higher risks to the market and investors.
Intermediaries with robust internal controls and good compliance records will likely face fewer, less intensive inspections.
The shift is expected to foster a more proactive regulatory environment, promoting overall market integrity and investor confidence.
caption:
Ever wondered if investing is getting safer for you? SEBI, the market watchdog, is making big changes! Instead of checking everyone the same way, they'll now focus more on companies that might be risky. This means less hassle for good companies, and more safety for your money. It's a smart move to protect your investments better. Read on to understand how this helps you.
